member.name: T:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorBoundaryTests
member.summary: Regression tests for the dataset generator's final-file boundary condition. Runtime capacities always sum exactly to the target, so generation must terminate at the target without ever requesting another extension.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorBoundaryTests.GenerateAsync_WhenTargetEqualsTotalCapacity_GeneratesExactlyTargetFiles
member.summary: Regression: when the target file count equals the sum of the runtime extension capacities, generation must complete exactly at the target, terminate immediately, and never request another extension.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorBoundaryTests.GenerateAsync_WhenTargetIsSmall_GeneratesExactlyTargetFiles
member.summary: Regression: small datasets must generate successfully even though most extensions receive zero capacity and are excluded from weighted selection. The runtime capacity distribution must be applied end to end.

member.name: T:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorCapacityTests
member.summary: Tests for the runtime extension-capacity allocation of the dataset generator. The capacities must always sum exactly to the target file count and must be deterministic for the same target.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorCapacityTests.BuildRuntimeCapacities_WhenTargetIsOneMillion_AllocatesExpectedDistribution
member.summary: For one million files every extension must receive its exact percentage share, and the allocation must be identical on every invocation.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorCapacityTests.BuildRuntimeCapacities_WhenTargetIsOneHundredThousand_SumsToTarget
member.summary: For one hundred thousand files the capacities must sum exactly to the target.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorCapacityTests.BuildRuntimeCapacities_WhenTargetIsTenThousand_SumsToTarget
member.summary: For ten thousand files the capacities must sum exactly to the target.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorCapacityTests.BuildRuntimeCapacities_WhenTargetIsOneHundred_SumsToTarget
member.summary: For one hundred files the capacities must sum exactly to the target.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorCapacityTests.BuildRuntimeCapacities_WhenTargetIsTen_SumsToTarget
member.summary: For ten files the largest-remainder allocation must distribute two remainder units deterministically, leaving extensions with small weights at zero capacity.

member.name: M:Jeninnet.AdvancedUsage.Tests.Evaluation.DatasetGeneratorCapacityTests.BuildRuntimeCapacities_WhenTargetIsOne_AllocatesExactlyOnePositiveCapacity
member.summary: For a single file exactly one extension must receive a positive capacity, and that extension must be the one with the largest weight.
